description: Execute arbitrary HomeMatic Script on the CCU. NOT idempotent — will not be auto-retried. Use for anything the other tools don't cover. On a protected target, EVERY call needs confirm:true — the session unlock from other write tools does not apply.

confirm.description: Required true on EVERY call against a protected CCU target (e.g. prod) — scripts never ride on the session unlock.

name: run_script
title: Run HomeMatic Script
